quality: A title starts soon after it is chosen
measure: seconds from play to the first picture, on each kind of device
today: not measured

quality: A title plays through without stalling
measure: stalls in an hour of playing
today: not measured; the apps send how playback went, and no page shows it

quality: It plays on the screens a household owns
measure: the kinds of device with an app, and where each is had
today: the web, Android and iOS phones and tablets, Android TV and Samsung TVs; none from a public store

quality: It speaks the household's languages
measure: the languages of the apps and the consoles
today: English

quality: People who see or hear less can use it
measure: the accessibility level the apps meet
today: none is stated, and no app is checked with a screen reader

quality: A new file is ready to watch without work
measure: steps by hand from a file's arrival to a title that plays
today: one: a scan, started by hand

quality: A title is recognised for what it is
measure: the share of titles matched without a hand
today: not measured

quality: Nothing of the library is lost
measure: what a dead disk costs
today: the bundled databases: up to a day, by their daily dumps; the files: what their storage keeps

quality: A title keeps the picture and the sound that matter
measure: what a package keeps of its original
today: every track in stereo, 5.1 where turned on, HDR10 or HLG; originals stay unless set to go

quality: A child sees only what it may
measure: ways around a rating cap
today: one: switching accounts on a shared device asks for nothing

quality: Someone who forgot a password is back in soon
measure: who resets it, and how
today: an admin, in the identity provider's console

quality: Someone who has not seen it installs it in an evening
measure: time from nothing to a film on the TV
today: not measured; a TV or a phone needs a name and an https certificate of one's own first

quality: It runs on the machine a household has
measure: the processors it runs on, and the memory it takes
today: amd64 alone; no smallest machine is named

quality: An update never leaves it broken
measure: what follows an update that fails
today: the platform checks itself after each update; nothing says how one is undone

quality: After a dead disk it is back, with little lost
measure: time and loss to a working platform on another machine
today: the bundled databases restore into the install that made them; there is no way to another machine

quality: Whoever runs it learns of a failure before the household does
measure: how a failure reaches them
today: it is shown in the portal to whoever looks; nothing is sent

quality: What an addon builds on stays as it is
measure: the promise on the platform's interfaces
today: none: the platform is at version 0, its resource at v1alpha1

quality: A security hole can be reported in private
measure: a policy that says where and how
today: none in any repository

quality: Every image can be traced to the source it was built from
measure: signatures, a record of each build, a list of what an image holds
today: none of the three

quality: What the apps send stays with whoever runs the server
measure: what leaves the apps for anyone else
today: nothing to their publisher; an avatar service, a font service and Google Cast are called

quality: A stranger can change it and have the change taken in
measure: a guide to contributing, and tests that run on every change
today: tests in the services' repositories; a guide in the operator's alone
